en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The impatient false oath leaves the houses deserted’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A binding oath which is false leaves the town barren.’”
